description: This PHP source file defines the 'SelectedDisplayFieldGroup' entity class for the OrangeHRM project, which maps to the 'ohrm_selected_display_field_group' database table. It includes properties for ID, associated Report, and DisplayFieldGroup entities, along with getter and setter methods. It also utilizes Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping and a trait for decorator functionality.
